lines.zh: 在水中蜿蜒前行，尾部拍打水面.
lines.en: Slither through water, tail slapping the surface.

lines.zh: 张开血盆大口，水中游动寻找猎物.
lines.en: Open wide, searching for prey in the water.

lines.zh: 用锋利牙齿捕食，猎物无处可逃.
lines.en: Use sharp teeth to hunt; prey has nowhere to hide.
Head for the surface, ready to attack.
Ram prey with powerful body.

lines.zh: 水面下快速滑行，避开敌人.
lines.en: Slide quickly underwater to avoid enemies.

lines.zh: 用强壮的尾巴搅动水花.
lines.en: Swing powerful tail, creating water splashes.

lines.zh: 吞下庞大的猎物，消化系统强大.
lines.en: Swallow large prey, strong digestive system.

lines.zh: 水面下潜游，耐心寻找机会.
lines.en: Submerge, patient and waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 利用强大肌肉在水中冲刺.
lines.en: Use strong muscles to dash in water.

lines.zh: 四鳍齐划，身形贴底滑行。
lines.en: All four flippers sweep; I glide along the bottom.

lines.zh: 吻部掠过海草，惊起鱼群。
lines.en: My snout sweeps the kelp and scatters the fish.
The sea splits around my long neck.
I circle the reef once.
Float quietly in water.

lines.zh: 张开大口，露出锋利牙齿.
lines.en: Open wide, revealing sharp teeth.
Move slowly in water.
Relish the calm of the water.
Surface, take a breath.
Breathe through nostrils, observing surroundings.
Stare at prey with eyes.
Submerge, slowly swimming.

lines.zh: 用皮肤感知周围的动静.
lines.en: Use skin to sense surroundings.
Use body posture to express dominance.
Spot player, quickly move closer.
Watch player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 张大嘴巴，露出锋利牙齿.
lines.en: Open mouth wide, revealing sharp teeth.
Move towards player, ready to hunt.
Stare intently at player.
Submerge and move, searching for target.

lines.zh: 用皮肤感受玩家的存在.
lines.en: Sense player's presence with skin.
Use body movements to intimidate player.

lines.zh: 迅速接近玩家，准备攻击.
lines.en: Swiftly approach player, ready to attack.
Submerge and stalk player.
My skin is tearing!
The water is biting me!
My scales are hurt!
My whip is injured!
My fins are hurt, I can't swim!
What's this doing to me?!
This attack hurts!
My muscles are torn!
The wound won't stop bleeding!
My whip is injured again!

lines.zh: 你靠近得太近了，水下猎物！
lines.en: You're too close, underwater prey!

lines.zh: 快游开，否则会一口吞了你！
lines.en: Move, or I'll swallow you whole!
You can't escape, I'm coming!

lines.zh: 我不会放过你的，水中的猎物。
lines.en: I won't let you go, underwater prey.
Feel my teeth!

lines.zh: 离我远一点，你闻起来像食物！
lines.en: Stay away, you smell like food!

lines.zh: 我的体型比你大得多，快滚开！
lines.en: My body is much larger, get out of here!
Stay out of my territory!
This is my food source!
You're next!
Collision brings danger!
Be careful, we're similar in size!

lines.zh: 在水里我一击就能咬穿。
lines.en: In water one bite of mine goes clean through.
Don't touch me, I'm stronger!
Colliding with me won't help!

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Stay away, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 你撞了我，现在我来撞你！
lines.en: You hit me, now I'll hit you!
Don't approach my boundary!
Don't challenge me!
There can only be one of us!
Mating season is here!

lines.zh: 我是这片水域的统治者！
lines.en: I'm the ruler of this water!

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，才能延续后代。
lines.en: Find a mate to continue our lineage.
No one in the water refuses me.
Come, I'll take you with me!
My strength can protect you!

lines.zh: 我们共筑爱巢，繁衍后代。
lines.en: We'll build a nest and have offspring together.
Only you can understand me!
Come, let's swim together!

lines.zh: 让我们一起度过这段美好时光。
lines.en: Let's spend this time together.

lines.zh: 沉重的鳞片在水中发出碰撞声。
lines.en: Scales clank in the water.

lines.zh: 它用利齿咬住你，吞下一切。
lines.en: It bites you, swallowing everything.

lines.zh: 触感冰凉的皮肤紧紧包裹着你。
lines.en: Colder-than-water skin clings to you.

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯在水中缓缓移动。
lines.en: A massive body moves through the water.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴在水面激起涟漪。
lines.en: Its tail sends ripples across the surface.

lines.zh: 你感到它的尖牙贴紧你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its sharp teeth press against your skin.

lines.zh: 水流中传来低沉的咆哮。
lines.en: Low growls echo in the water.

lines.zh: 它用巨大的爪子抓住你。
lines.en: It grabs you with its huge claws.
Cold green eyes gaze at you.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤在阳光下闪着微光。
lines.en: Its skin glimmers under the sunlight.

lines.zh: 你似乎触动了它的领地。
lines.en: You've entered its territory.

lines.zh: 它的目光变得锐利，瞄准你。
lines.en: Its gaze sharpens on you.

lines.zh: 它慢慢接近，张开血盆大口。
lines.en: It approaches, mouth wide open.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它的呼吸在耳边。
lines.en: You feel its breath on your face.

lines.zh: 它开始用尾部拍打水面。
lines.en: It begins to slap the water with its tail.
Its muscles tense in the water.
You smell its foul stench.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤在水面摩擦作响。
lines.en: Its skin rubs against the water.
Its voice echoes underwater.
Its shadow sways across the shallows.
That is blood in the water, no mistake.
You are smaller than me. That is enough.
One sweep of a flipper and I turn to you.

lines.zh: 你踩着水底，像条受伤的鱼。
lines.en: You stumble on the bottom like a wounded fish.
These waters have a guest today.

lines.zh: 我把目标定在你的腿上。
lines.en: I set my aim on your legs.
I never blink. The fish understand.

lines.zh: 你成了它的下一个目标。
lines.en: You're its next target.
I hug the seafloor and rise toward it.
Its gaze is greedy.
You feel its anger.

lines.zh: 它打算从水中一跃而起。
lines.en: It plans to leap out of the water.
Its tentacles move in the water.
It prepares to tear you apart.
Its body tenses on the water.
It prepares to release venom.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，贴住海床。
lines.en: I drop low and hug the sea floor.

lines.zh: 长颈微微一缩，准备弹出。
lines.en: My neck draws back, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 鱼群往两边逃，你也该逃。
lines.en: The fish flee. You should be fleeing too.

lines.zh: 我的牙列在阴影里发白。
lines.en: My teeth shine white in the gloom.

lines.zh: 水流把你推向我的方向。
lines.en: The current pushes you toward me.
My flippers still as I gather power.
The sand under you begins to slide.

lines.zh: 水面的光亮被我挡住了。
lines.en: I have blocked out the light above you.
I count your strokes.
I have judged the distance for this bite.
One bite and not even bones are left.
Water rage!
I'm the lord!
Tear your flesh!
One bite underwater and you are gone.
Feel my fangs!
This trench belongs to me.
Nothing in the water outswims me.
Devour you!
My jaws snap your leg!
My neck whips and slams you down!

lines.zh: 鳍肢扇起的暗流掀翻你！
lines.en: My flipper's wake capsizes you!
Rows of teeth close on you!
I drag you into deep water!
The spray is all blood!
Once I bite, I do not let go!
I ram you into the reef!
My tail sweeps, water like a whip!
One gulp takes your shoulder!
The power of the deep bears down!
On land I cannot move at all.
I smelled the blood first, down in the deep.
Swim or die!
Beneath the waves!
Solitary hunter!
However far I swim, this sea feels shallow.
Predator of the dark!
Watch from the depths!
Devour all!
I lift my head out of the silt.
The DNA in the fossil has woken.
I swim out of the trench's dark.

lines.zh: 鳍肢第一划，海水就翻腾。
lines.en: One sweep of my flippers and the sea churns.
The Jurassic sea has returned.
The flames burn me!
Fell into the water!
Drowned in the water!
Explosion splashed me!
The beam hit me!
Magic burns me!
Hunger weakens me!
Lightning strikes me!
The void tears me!
